propositions: a rejected auto-push reports success locally while diverging from remote, with the rejection reason and git output discarded, remaining invisible to the writing caller for hours

the rejection classifier _NON_FF matches the bare substring 'rejected' in policy-decline lines (hook declined, push protection), routing them into retriable non-fast-forward logic and skipping the only stderr-bearing log call
the PUSH_PENDING divergence signal is computed only on explicit `rebar fsck`, never consulted by write paths, so the same one-shot warning scrolls off screen while the backlog silently escalates
on sync.push=async the push is a detached Popen with stderr=DEVNULL, making the warning completely undeliverable to the writing agent
ticket event payloads (comments with raw environment output) are never scanned for secrets on write, unlike code which passes through a gitleaks gate
